scenarios.name: Full Feature Baseline
scenarios.description: All 30 canonical features present without missing data

scenarios.name: Missing Webpage / HTML Signals
scenarios.description: Website offline or blocked; 10 DOM features safely imputed by KNN

scenarios.name: Missing External / WHOIS APIs
scenarios.description: Third-party APIs unreachable; 6 external features safely imputed by KNN

scenarios.name: Lexical-Only (URL Syntax Alone)
scenarios.description: Zero network/web access; only 14 lexical URL signals available

key_findings: Under complete features, the Random Forest model achieves 97.29% accuracy, 97.24% precision, 97.63% F1, and 3.68% FPR.
When website HTML is unavailable, KNN imputer preserves 92.09% accuracy and 93.24% F1 without crashing or issuing false alarms.
When third-party WHOIS and traffic APIs are unreachable, the model preserves 93.44% accuracy and 94.29% F1.
In extreme offline lexical-only conditions (16 of 30 features missing), the model retains 89.15% accuracy and 90.61% F1.
Empirical results prove the pipeline is robust to missing features and does NOT automatically flag URLs as phishing merely because network access fails.
